name: UPSC CSE
tagline: The mothership — IAS, IPS, IFS and 20+ services.
overview: Three-stage marathon: Prelims (objective, qualifying), Mains (9 descriptive papers) and Personality Test. Prelims GS-I decides the cutoff; CSAT is qualifying at 33%.

notes: Cutoff is decided on this paper only

sections.name: GS Paper I — Heritage, Culture, History, Geography
GS Paper II — Governance, Polity, Social Justice, IR
GS Paper III — Technology, Economy, Environment, Security
GS Paper IV — Ethics, Integrity, Aptitude

notes: 7 merit papers = 1750 marks; 2 qualifying papers (300 each, 25% to pass)

trends: Heavy current-affairs + static linkage questions ('Consider the following pairs/statements')
Map-based and art & culture questions are rising
Economy questions increasingly applied (inflation, banking terms) rather than pure theory
Environment overlaps with schemes (MISHTI, Amrit Dharohar style)
CSAT difficulty fluctuating — never neglect it (qualifying 33%)

samples.q: Which of the following statements regarding the President of India is/are correct? 1. The President can be removed only for violation of the Constitution. 2. The President's veto over Money Bills is absolute.
samples.x: Statement 2 is wrong: the President cannot withhold assent to Money Bills — Article 111 makes his assent effectively mandatory. Removal under Article 61 is only for violation of the Constitution.

samples.q: Consider the following pairs (National Park : State) — 1. Bandhavgarh : Madhya Pradesh, 2. Similipal : Odisha, 3. Namdapha : Arunachal Pradesh. How many pairs are correctly matched?
samples.x: All three are correct. Bandhavgarh (MP), Similipal (Odisha), Namdapha (Arunachal Pradesh).

samples.q: Which of the following is NOT a component of the monetary policy framework of the RBI?
samples.x: Fiscal deficit target is part of fiscal policy (government budget), not RBI's monetary policy toolkit.

samples.q: The 'Great Barrier Reef' is located off the coast of which country?
samples.x: Great Barrier Reef lies in the Coral Sea off Queensland, Australia — the world's largest coral reef system.

samples.q: With reference to 'Bharat Stage (BS) VI' emission norms, consider: 1. They cap particulate matter (PM) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) from vehicles. 2. BS-VI fuel has lower sulphur content than BS-IV. Which is/are correct?
samples.x: BS-VI tightened PM/NOx limits and mandated 10 ppm sulphur fuel (vs 50 ppm in BS-IV). Both correct.

samples.q: If the 4th day of a month is Friday, which day will be the 26th day of the same month?
Which Part of the Constitution of India contains the Directive Principles of State Policy?
samples.x: Directive Principles are in Part IV (Articles 36–51); Fundamental Rights are in Part III.

samples.q: The Dandi March of 1930 began from which place?
samples.x: Gandhi began the Salt Satyagraha march from Sabarmati Ashram on 12 March 1930 and reached Dandi on 6 April.

samples.q: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bengal'?
samples.x: The Damodar, flowing through Jharkhand and West Bengal, was called the 'Sorrow of Bengal' for its floods.

samples.q: In India, wholesale price inflation is primarily measured by which index?
samples.x: The WPI tracks wholesale price changes; the RBI's inflation targeting uses CPI (retail).

samples.q: Kaziranga National Park is famous for the conservation of which species?
samples.x: Kaziranga (Assam) holds the world's largest population of the one-horned rhinoceros.

samples.q: Which was India's first mission to the Moon?
samples.x: Chandrayaan-1 (2008) was India's first lunar probe; it confirmed water molecules on the Moon.

samples.q: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) came into effect across India on which date?
samples.x: GST was rolled out on 1 July 2017, subsuming most indirect taxes under 'one nation, one tax'.

samples.q: A number is divisible by both 3 and 5. By which of the following must it also be divisible?
samples.x: If a number is divisible by co-prime numbers 3 and 5, it is divisible by their product 15.

samples.q: Under Article 110, a Money Bill can be introduced only:
samples.x: A Money Bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha and only with the President's recommendation.

samples.q: The rock-cut caves of Ajanta are primarily associated with which religion?
samples.x: The Ajanta caves (Maharashtra) are Buddhist monuments famous for their paintings and sculpture.
